New standards and Amendments to standard:
Amendments to IAS 21 Lack of Exchangeability
(Amendments to IAS 21)
Executive Summary:
Under the amendments, companies will need to provide new
disclosures to help users assess the impact of using an esti-
mated exchange rate on the financial statements.

New standards and Amendments to standard:
Amendments to the Classification and Measure-
ment of Financial Instruments (Amendments to IFRS
9 and IFRS 7)
Executive Summary:
The amendments include guidance on the classification of fi-
nancial assets, including those with contingent features.
